specifications.title: Rejecting an application that does not exist
specifications.given: no application exists with the given id
specifications.when: the shelter owner attempts to reject it
specifications.then: a Not Found result is returned and no integration event is produced
specifications.rule: Only an application under review can be rejected by its shelter owner

specifications.title: Rejecting an application under review
specifications.given: an application submitted for a dog listing is under review
specifications.when: the shelter owner rejects it with a reason
specifications.then: the application status becomes Rejected and an ApplicationRejected event is produced carrying the dog's name and the rejection reason
specifications.rule: Only an application under review can be rejected by its shelter owner
